data.title: Split Around
data.statement:
You receive a string [[s]] and [[n]] search strings [[x]].

For every occurrence of each [[x]], split [[s]] immediately before and immediately after the matching text. <<Keep the matching text>> in the result.

Matches are <<case-sensitive>>. Search the original [[s]] for every [[x]]. Preserve all characters, including spaces. Do not produce empty fragments.

Print the fragments in their original order. If nothing matches, [[s]] is the only fragment. Use the format described in Output.

<<Example:>>
For [[s]] = {{red cat and dog!}} and the search strings {{cat}} and {{dog}}, the output is:
{{"red ", "cat", " and ", "dog", "!"}}

lastVersion.statementHTML:
Goal

You receive a string s and n search strings x.

For every occurrence of each x, split s immediately before and immediately after the matching text. Keep the matching text in the result.

Matches are case-sensitive. Search the original s for every x. Preserve all characters, including spaces. Do not produce empty fragments.

Print the fragments in their original order. If nothing matches, s is the only fragment. Use the format described in Output.

Example:
For s = red cat and dog! and the search strings cat and dog, the output is:
"red ", "cat", " and ", "dog", "!"
Input
Line 1: A string s.
Line 2: An integer n, the number of search strings.
Next n lines: One search string x per line.

Read s and each x as whole lines, including spaces.
Output
Line 1: The non-empty fragments in their original order, each enclosed in double quotation marks. Separate consecutive fragments with a comma followed by one space. Preserve spaces inside each fragment.
Constraints
1 <= length of x < length of s <= 200
1 <= n <= 9
s contains only printable ASCII characters (codes 32 to 126), except double quotation marks and backslashes.
Each x contains only ASCII letters, digits and spaces, with no leading or trailing spaces.
All x strings are distinct. Their occurrences in s never overlap; adjacent occurrences are allowed.
Example
Input
red cat and dog!
2
cat
dog
Output
"red ", "cat", " and ", "dog", "!"
